name: SAMAIDEN
recent: Samaiden 近期公布 LSS5+ 太阳能项目合约价值 RM238 million，并获券商点名订单前景可期。公司同时发布 2026 年报与股东大会议程，并有多项董事及高管售股申报。
notable: 公布 LSS5+ 太阳能项目合约价值 RM238 million。
发布 2026 年报及第 7 届常年股东大会通知。
risks: 独立非执行主席 Dato' Dr Nadzri Bin Yahaya 在公开市场多次售股。
首席策略官 Dr Tee Wu Shun 在公开市场多次售股。
公司持续进行库存股变动，可能影响股本结构。
earnings: 2026 财年末季营收按季增长 55.8%，净利按季增长 61.8%；营收按年下降 21.6%，但净利按年增长 107.7%，净利率由 13.4% 升至 14.0%。

recent_en: Samaiden recently disclosed an RM238 million contract value for an LSS5+ solar project and was cited by brokers for its order book prospects. The company also issued its 2026 annual report and AGM agenda, alongside several director and senior management share disposal filings.
notable_en: Disclosed RM238 million contract value for an LSS5+ solar project.
Issued 2026 annual report and notice of 7th AGM.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Dato' Dr Nadzri Bin Yahaya disposed shares in the open market multiple times.
Chief Strategy Officer Dr Tee Wu Shun disposed shares in the open market multiple times.
Ongoing changes in treasury shares may affect share capital structure.
earnings_en: 4QFY2026 revenue rose 55.8% QoQ and net profit rose 61.8% QoQ; revenue fell 21.6% YoY while net profit grew 107.7% YoY, with net margin improving from 13.4% to 14.0%.
